== Strategy ==

I intend to use the Jedi Levitation, Control & Tunnel Vision, and Speak With The Jedi Council to pull my sites and other important items.

I plan to use the Wokling to pull the celebration and Starships, characters and weapons are all pullable as long as you have either the character of the ship.
